source: 5. Why can document parsing fail before retrieval even begins, especially for PDFs, tables, and structured documents? [Intermediate - Production] Retrieval can only search what ingestion preserved. Real PDFs and web documents contain headings, columns, footnotes, tables, page furniture, reading-order ambiguities, scanned text, and sometimes figures whose structure disappears under naive text extraction. A parser can therefore corrupt the evidence before chunking or embedding
zh: 5. 为什么在检索开始之前文档解析就会失败，特别是对于 PDF、表格和结构化文档？ [中级 - 生产] 检索只能搜索保留的摄取内容。真实的 PDF 和 Web 文档包含标题、栏目、脚注、表格、页面结构、阅读顺序歧义、扫描文本，有时还包含其结构在简单文本提取下消失的图形。因此，解析器可以在分块或嵌入之前破坏证据
